title: Food and Drinks
summary: Learn how to name common food and drinks in English. Practice ordering what you like to eat and drink.

sections.p: We eat food every day. When we talk about food we like, we use simple words. For breakfast, lunch, or dinner, we can eat fruit, bread, or rice. Let us learn the names of some very popular foods that people eat all over the world.

ex.en: I eat an apple every day.
ex.mean: Apples are a healthy fruit that I eat daily.
A question asking if bread is tasty to you.

sections.p: When you are thirsty, you need a drink. Water is the best drink for your body. Many people also drink tea or coffee in the morning, and cold juice when the weather is hot. Let us learn how to talk about these drinks.

ex.en: I want a glass of water, please.
ex.mean: A polite way to ask for water.
Tea is her favorite morning drink.

sections.p: It is easy to talk about what you want to eat or drink. You can say 'I like' for things you enjoy, or 'I want' when you are ordering food in a shop or restaurant. Polite words like 'please' are very important.

ex.mean: Bananas are a fruit that I enjoy eating.
A short and polite way to order coffee.

words.mean: a round red or green fruit
a hot drink made with leaves

tip: Look at the food in your kitchen and say their English names out loud. It helps you remember them fast!
